name: 14534 · Pittsford, NY
findings: ZIP 14534 (Pittsford) has 163 nonprofit organizations. 67 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14534 (Pittsford) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 30 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
